context shim (identical on both sides): infixowl_shim.py holds classOrIdentifier copied verbatim from infixowl.py lines 237-243, with Class/Property reduced to the marker classes the isinstance test needs (the region only reads .identifier).

the drafted @prefix rdf:/rdfs: declarations were dropped: RDF.type is written 'a' and RDFS is unused in the region, so no prefix is needed at all. The rdflib import line is left exactly as upstream even though RDF becomes dead there.

'graph.add(triple)' becomes 'graph += <one-triple graph>'; rdflib set semantics make this observationally identical (the driver compares by isomorphism, two fixtures: three members incl. a Class instance and a BNode, and the empty early-return path).
